source: spec A10 steps 5-6 and DTC-03 optimize_daily/weekly; every threshold is t.<name> from thresholds.gads

tables.search_terms: per campaign + ad_group + search_term over the window: cost, clicks, conversions, conv_value, roas, match_type
tables.products: per item_id over the window: clicks, cost, conversions, conv_value, roas, days_live
tables.campaigns: per campaign: cost, conversions, roas, lost_is_budget, budget, bidding, target_roas, cost_7d, conv_7d, conv_30d, roas_30d, days_since_budget_change, days_since_target_change, days_below_breakeven

rules.judgment: {campaign} spent {cost_7d} in 7 days with no conversion (stop-loss is {t.stop_loss_cpa_mult}x the target CPA of {ctx.target_cpa})

rules.unless_reason: campaign is in its learning window
rules.judgment: '{search_term}' cost {cost} with no conversion ({t.neg_cost_mult_cpa}x the target CPA of {ctx.target_cpa})

rules.when: conversions >= t.harvest_min_conv and roas >= ctx.target_roas and match_type != 'exact'
rules.unless_reason: campaign is in its learning window

rules.when: not (days_live != None and days_live < t.new_label_days) and conversions == 0 and clicks >= t.zombie_clicks
not (days_live != None and days_live < t.new_label_days) and conversions >= 1 and roas >= t.hero_roas_mult * ctx.target_roas
rules.judgment: {item_id} returns ROAS {roas}, at least {t.hero_roas_mult}x the target {ctx.target_roas}

rules.when: lost_is_budget >= t.limited_lost_is_budget and roas >= ctx.target_roas and (days_since_budget_change == None or days_since_budget_change >= t.budget_step_min_days)
rules.unless_reason: campaign is in its learning window
rules.judgment: {campaign} is limited by budget (lost {lost_is_budget} of impressions) at ROAS {roas}, above the target {ctx.target_roas}

rules.unless_reason: campaign is in its learning window
rules.judgment: {campaign} has been below the break-even ROAS {ctx.breakeven_roas} for {days_below_breakeven} days

rules.unless_reason: campaign is in its learning window
rules.judgment: {campaign} has {conv_30d} conversions in 30 days, enough to bid for conversion value

rules.when: bidding in ['max_conversions', 'max_conv_value'] and target_roas == None and conv_30d >= t.conv_for_troas
rules.unless_reason: campaign is in its learning window
rules.judgment: {campaign} has {conv_30d} conversions in 30 days at ROAS {roas_30d}: set a target a little below it

rules.when: bidding == 'troas' and target_roas != None and roas_30d != None and (days_since_target_change == None or days_since_target_change >= t.target_step_days) and abs(roas_30d * (1 - t.troas_below_observed) - target_roas) / target_roas > 0.05
rules.unless_reason: campaign is in its learning window

target.expr: round(min(max(roas_30d * (1 - t.troas_below_observed), target_roas * (1 - t.target_step_max)), target_roas * (1 + t.target_step_max)), 2)

rules.judgment: {campaign} runs at ROAS {roas_30d} against a target of {target_roas}: move the target at most {t.target_step_max} toward it
